content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the chemical breakdown of carbohydrates, proteins, and lipids
State the products of digesting each nutrient type
Explain the roles of different enzymes in digestion
Understand how conditions in different parts of the gut affect digestion

uses enzymes to break down large food molecules into smaller ones. Different enzymes digest different nutrients, and each works best under specific conditions. This lesson follows the chemical breakdown of each nutrient type through the digestive system.
